name: Ferruginous-Inselberg
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in a nearby asteroid belt. Travelers navigate by bioluminescent seas and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
